content.title: Drawn-Energy Takeover | Object Morphs, Motion Registration and Room Rewrite
content.summary: A chalk ribbon ray transforms objects before redrawing a repair kiosk. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One continuous hand-drawn carrier persists. + Every form change follows visible contact. + Handheld camera drift and drawn motion remain registered. + Escalation moves from local object to room scale. + The final graphic world preserves the original physical layout.
quick_start.recommended_input: Begin in an original late-night repair kiosk filmed with restrained handheld drift and no graphic effects. Let the ray touch a hanging cable, tool pouch and fan; it becomes a knot, fish and wheel while preserving one violet tail. Expand the tram trail into a star map that redraws every wall and object while the live room geometry remains registered.
required_anchors: Every form change follows visible contact.
Escalation moves from local object to room scale.
The final graphic world preserves the original physical layout.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A chalk ribbon ray transforms objects before redrawing a repair kiosk. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 一条可追踪手绘能量贴合手持实景运动，依次变成浮游生物、织物符号、鱼形与列车轨迹；每次换形都由接触触发，最终从局部线条扩散为整屋星空涂鸦。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One continuous hand-drawn carrier persists."

invariants.rule: Every form change follows visible contact.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every form change follows visible contact."

invariants.rule: Handheld camera drift and drawn motion remain registered.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Handheld camera drift and drawn motion remain registered."

invariants.rule: Escalation moves from local object to room scale.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Escalation moves from local object to room scale."

invariants.rule: The final graphic world preserves the original physical layout.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final graphic world preserves the original physical layout."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
